query: SELECT g,arraySum(i -> if(samples[i].2 < samples[i-1].2, samples[i-1].2, 0), range(2,length(samples)+1)) FROM (SELECT number%2 g,groupArray(tuple(number,toFloat64(number))) samples FROM numbers(16000) GROUP BY g) FORMAT JSON
